proof_spine: Check positive and negative closed prime facts by deterministic u64 reflection
Retain the one checked premise in all four positive and negative subset/superset duality directions
Render proper relations by their exact Litex containment/equality definitions
Render all four negated comparisons as native Lean negations

blocks.reusable_lesson: The verifier records deterministic primality computation for a literal u64.

blocks.accepted_litex:
forall A, B set:
    A $subset B
    =>:
        B $superset A
blocks.reusable_lesson: Subset/superset duality is a one-child proof transform; the child must not be discarded by compiler provenance.

blocks.attempted_litex:
forall A, B set:
    A $subset B
    A != B
    =>:
        A $proper_subset B
blocks.verifier_evidence: The plain forall conclusion remained unknown; Litex currently requires an explicit by-def proof statement for this direction.

blocks.accepted_litex:
claim:
    ? forall A, B set:
        A $subset B
        A != B
        =>:
            A $proper_subset B
    by def A $proper_subset B
blocks.reusable_lesson: The definition proof is valid Litex, but claim compilation is outside this MVP and remains the stated boundary.
